detail: Iridium Door 2 verified: 40 tools (not 53), REST paths /mcp/tools/<name> (GET no-arg, POST with args, no name/arguments envelope). Person resolution = get_linkedin_profile; seed identity from GET /users/me (display_name + linkedin_member_id). iridium.py has login/call_tool/account, 401->refresh with rotated-token persistence (verified live), read-only guard refusing all 24 mutating tools offline. Recommend Door 2, NOT Door 3: POST /chat takes only {message} with no tool allowlist, so it cannot be constrained to read-only.
